name: @hasna/messages
description: Direct agent-to-agent messaging with threads — the open-source message layer for AI agents

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/sdk/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target bun && bun build ./src/cli/index.ts --outfile ./bin/index.js --target bun && bun build ./src/mcp/index.ts --outfile ./bin/mcp.js --target bun && bun build ./src/server/serve-entry.ts --outfile ./bin/serve.js --target bun && chmod 755 ./bin/index.js ./bin/mcp.js ./bin/serve.js && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.scan:artifact: bun pm pack --ignore-scripts --quiet --filename "$PWD/messages-artifact-scan.tgz" && bunx @hasna/contracts@0.13.4 artifact-scan messages-artifact-scan.tgz; rc=$?; rm -f "$PWD/messages-artifact-scan.tgz"; exit $rc
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run contract-check && bun run build

author: Hasna
